content: Marcus Clement is a University of Washington Informatics student focused on data science. He builds practical things that make work easier — features, workflows, and automated systems. His work sits between software and analytics. He enjoys owning problems end to end: understanding needs, building simple solutions, then iterating until reliable. Lately that means cloud and data work plus LLM-powered tooling. Outside school and work he enjoys running, lifting, hiking, and golfing. Core skills: Cloud Architecture, Full Stack Development, Data, AI/LLM Integration, Consulting.

Marcus attends the University of Washington (GPA 3.9) in Seattle, pursuing a B.S. in Informatics (Data Science) (Sep 2025 - Jun 2027). Before that he completed an Associate's in Arts and Sciences at Bellevue College (Sep 2023 - Jun 2025).

Software Engineer Intern at Socratics.ai (Mar 2026 - Present). Socratics.ai is a startup — Marcus has direct startup experience here. Building a full-stack financial document processing pipeline supporting Excel ingestion, AI-suggested classifications, human-in-the-loop interface, and structured data export. Collaborating with cross-functional team and product stakeholders. Marcus originally consulted for Socratics.ai through the Business Impact Group and was invited back for a full internship based on his performance.

AI Product Engineer Intern at AirPLAi Sports (Jan 2026 - Mar 2026). AirPLAi is a startup — Marcus has direct startup experience here. Tuning AI chatbot prompt workflows and data retrieval logic in Python (FastAPI / LangGraph). Creating UI and backend features, debugging, running tests, resolving CI/Dev issues (GCP, Docker, React / Next.js). Building cloud-based data pipelines that improve data reliability and operational workflows.

Full Stack Developer at Web Impact UW (Jan 2026 - Present). Developing features across React frontend, API routes, and backend. Collaborating cross-functionally with design and product leads to deliver user-focused web solutions for external clients. Implementing UI components with shadcn and delivering maintainable code through GitHub workflows.

Member Service Agent at Costco Wholesale (Feb 2024 - Present). On the College Retention Program since Sep 2025. Assisted customers through complex issues via chat/phone, translating technical processes into clear explanations. Consistently exceeded performance expectations by over 50% through strong communication and problem-solving.

Data Science Intern at Everlane Landscaping (Aug 2025 - Nov 2025). Built automated Python pipeline to process 100+ monthly logs, optimizing routing and reducing job-time by 15%. Developed Tableau dashboards that improved reporting accuracy by 25%. Conducted data modeling to identify high-value customer segments, leading to 12% increase in customer retention.

Cursor-Inspired Portfolio (marcusclementportfolio.vercel.app). A personal portfolio that makes browsing feel familiar and intuitive to developers. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks — and deployed on Vercel. Designed to mimic the Cursor IDE with a file explorer sidebar, tabbed editor pane, and AI chat panel. Features include drag-and-drop tab reordering, a resizable AI sidebar, and a fully functional AI chatbot.

The portfolio chatbot is powered by Claude Haiku 4.5 via the Anthropic API with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). It uses a structured JSON knowledge base with topic chunks covering Marcus's experience, projects, skills, and certifications. When a user sends a message, keyword-based retrieval scores each chunk against the query and injects the top 3 most relevant chunks into the system prompt for grounded, accurate responses. Responses are streamed in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE) through a Vercel serverless function. The backend includes rate limiting, CORS validation, input sanitization, and security headers. The frontend features starter prompts, auto-scroll during streaming, and an info modal explaining the architecture. The entire implementation uses no frameworks — just vanilla JavaScript on the frontend and a single serverless function on the backend.

Nick-Blendz.com — Online Booking Application (Jun 2025 - Jul 2025). Built and deployed a full-stack booking platform with Next.js, TypeScript, and AWS (EC2, S3, RDS) supporting 100+ users. Designed the database schema and backend to manage scheduling and client data, cutting manual booking work by 80%. Integrated scheduling API and analytics dashboards.

Medi-Scribe — AI Medical Transcriber (Sep 2025 - Present). Developing a HIPAA-compliant transcription system using AWS (S3, Lambda, Transcribe Medical, Bedrock) and React. Automates audio capture, transcription, and clinical summarization.

Document Management System (Jun 2024 - Jul 2024). Built a PostgreSQL-based document management system for a real estate investor. Designed a relational schema and SQL backend using JSON to streamline property and record management.

AWS Certifications: Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02), AI Practitioner (AIF-C01), preparing for Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03). Azure Certifications: AZ-900 (Azure Fundamentals), AI-900 (Azure AI Fundamentals), DP-900 (Azure Data Fundamentals).

Languages & backend: Python, R, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, FastAPI. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML & CSS. Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Vercel. Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP. Data & analytics: SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, Excel. AI: Quick Suite, Gemini Gems, LangGraph, MCP, RAG, Claude Code. LLMs: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini.

Marcus has done extensive research on Quick Suite and studied many demos on best practices. He knows how to create workflows, custom chatbots, and how to leverage features like connectors, MCP, and best practices in agentic workflows.
Marcus has played around with Gemini Gems on his personal account and has watched demos on the enterprise version. He has seen hands-on how to work with that tool.
Email: mvcus8235@gmail.com. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marcus-clement27.

Community involvement: Business Impact Group (Consultant, Jan-Mar 2026, collaborated with Socratics.ai and was invited back for internship), Web Impact UW (Full Stack Developer), NetworkAI (Director of Technology, leading AI workshops and all club tech events), Kappa Theta Pi (professional technology fraternity, worked in cross-functional team to create and deploy fraternity webpage), AWS Cloud Club (member, building projects and attending workshops/hackathons), Claude Builder Club (member, building projects and attending workshops/hackathons), Newman Center (Student Ministry Team Member since Sep 2025).

The portfolio is designed to mimic the Cursor IDE interface with a dark theme. It has three main panels: a file explorer sidebar on the left listing pages as files (about.md, experience.md, projects.md, etc.), a central editor pane with a tab system for switching between pages, and an AI chat sidebar on the right. Users can drag and drop to reorder tabs, resize the AI panel, and interact with the chatbot. The site is fully responsive — on mobile it collapses to a single-column layout. All content is rendered client-side from a JavaScript data object with no build step or framework.
